subject: Adjusting today's product walkthrough due to exec overlap
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novuspay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: stakeholders@novuspay.com
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need to shift today's walkthrough (exec overlap)

Hi Marissa,

Apologies for the short notice — an investor prep meeting just moved into our execs' calendars and it collides with our 11:30 PT walkthrough.

We still want to see Redwood today, but would it be possible to either: 1) push the session back ~90 minutes (1:00pm PT start) so our CFO can join, or 2) run a 30-minute exec-level overview at the scheduled time and do the technical deep-dive with your SE next week?

We have 4 execs who ideally join the first block, plus the engineering leads for the deep-dive. I've attached a quick stakeholder list.

Thank you — Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of Product, NovusPay
elena@novuspay.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: novuspay-stakeholder-list.csv (2 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to shift today's walkthrough (exec overlap)

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the stakeholder list. Totally understood on the investor meeting.

Two ways we can handle this today:
• Option A — move the full session to 1:00pm PT (90 minutes later). We'll send an updated invite; Rishi can cover the whole session if needed.
• Option B — keep the 11:30am PT slot as a 30-minute executive overview (high-level product + cost/latency summary) and schedule a separate 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with Rishi next week for the eng team. We'll record both.

If you prefer Option B, we'll include a short recording and a recording owner for the execs who can't attend. I've attached a draft agenda for the 30-minute exec block so you can confirm the scope.

Which would you prefer? If you want option A, I can update the calendar now.

Thanks — Marissa

--

marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0142

Marissa — I can cover either. If we do Option B (split), I can take the technical deep-dive next week (Tue/Wed morning PT are best for me).

A couple operational notes:
• If we split, I'd suggest the exec 30-min includes 5 min for next steps and a single action item to book the deep-dive with the engineering leads.
• I'll own the recording and upload to Drive; please add me as calendar owner so I can start the recording and post the link.

Also, if you push to 1pm, I'm on standby but will be in transit between customers at 12:30–1:30 PT; Lauren, can you cover the demo if Marissa moves the time?

-Rishi

Thanks — we're going with Option B.

• Keep the 11:30am PT slot as a 30-minute exec overview (high level, value props, cost/latency highlights). Execs will mostly be there for the first 20 minutes.
• Schedule a separate technical deep-dive for next week with your SE. Rishi, can you do Tuesday 10:00am PT or Wednesday 9:00am PT? Either works for engineering.

Please: send an updated calendar invite for today (30-min) that indicates the follow-up deep-dive will be scheduled, and include the recording owner. Also confirm that the session will be recorded and the recording link shared with the execs afterwards.

Appreciate the flexibility.
